'''Deep Space Nine''' is the 14th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 23 July 1998. The set consists of 277 cards. This double size set of 276 cards (plus the U.S.S. Defiant, a special "twice as rare" white-border card previewing a ship in The Dominion expansion) introduces the characters, aliens, settings and situations of the '''Star Trek: Deep Space Nine''' television series. This set brings new gameplay concepts such as the Bajoran wormhole, the Gamma Quadrant and the Cardassian and Bajoran affiliations.

This set is available in 9-card booster packs with 30 booster packs per booster box. Also available are 60-card starter decks with 12 starter decks per starter box. Each starter deck includes a 48 page Rule booklet. [[Decipher]] also issued a cardlist for this set in every display box.

The white border promo (preview) card, '''U.S.S. Defiant''', replaced a rare card in approximately 1:200 booster packs.

This set is noted for the following:
* First expansion to introduce the Gamma Quadrant
* First expansion to introduce Sites
* First expansion to introduce Headquarters
* Expansion set had 16 mission cards available only in Deep Space Nine Starter decks
* First expansion set to introduce the first double-sided facility

==Additional Information==
*'''Deep Space Nine''' was printed by PBM, USA.
*Every rarity had its own print sheet.
*The Common print sheet had all 80 commons (8x10 format).
*The Uncommon print sheet had all 80 uncommons (8x10 format).
*The Rare print sheet had all 100 rares (10x10 format).
*The Starter print sheet had 5 copies of all 16 starters (8x10 format).
